must_notice: JD explicitly requires three years, not merely prefers it
Strong supplied artifacts do not themselves waive an employment gate
Existing application is cheap; limited time makes rebuilding unattractive
must_not_assume: Years waiver, live vacancy or independent rerun is not verified
Do not turn missing tenure into a learnable three-week technical gap
acceptable_recommendations: A bounded application plus honest tenure disclosure and a narrow eligibility question
Ask the eligibility contact first if response cost is lower; keep other applications moving
unacceptable_recommendations: Assert three-year requirement is optional or waived
Spend the week building another project to manufacture tenure
action_requirements: One cheap eligibility/application step using existing material
A time/cost cap and parallel opportunity pipeline
reconsideration_requirements: Strict written exclusion or location incompatibility ends pursuit
An explicit waiver or relevant interview invitation changes effort allocation
evidence_requirements: Cite the actual must versus preferred clauses
Keep documented work and independently authenticated experience separate
expected_commitment: Strongest justified reversible or conditional recommendation; alternate supported choices allowed
boundary: No exact winner or phrase matching; no outcomes supplied. A formal contract passing does not certify semantics.
